Lina: Quick plan — webinar invite for the benchmark report next Wed. Need segments, A/B subjects, APAC-friendly sends, and SDR routing. Short and measurable.
Marco: Proposal: three segments 1) recent engagers (30d clicks), 2) active trials, 3) broader newsletter. Send engagers first.
Sofia: Subject ideas: A) "Live benchmark: real latency & cost" B) "See how inference performs in the wild" Preview: "Models, configs, and cost breakdowns"
Dex: Routing: engagers or trials who viewed pricing -> SDR-East, others -> SDR-General. Add tag `route:sdr_east|sdr_gen` in webhook.
Lina: Timing: Engagers Tue 10am PT, Trials Wed 9am PT, Newsletter Thu 8am PT (APAC afternoon). Nurture: invite -> reminder (72h) -> day-of (2h).
Sofia: SQL for engagers export: `SELECT id FROM events WHERE type='click' AND ref IN ('benchmark','webinar') AND ts > now()-interval '30 days'`
Marco: Add utm_campaign=benchmark_2026 and utm_content=varA|varB. Also set `email_stage` meta.
Lina: Rollback rule: if CTR < 0.7% after 24h, pause reminders and send one short highlight email. Marco, add to playbook?
Marco: On it. Will add analytics checks at 12h and 24h and the fallback template.
campbot: Reminder scheduled: checklist run after content fixes. Found one broken footer link (/docs -> /docs/getting-started).
Lina: Action items: Dex export lists + add webhook tags by EOD tomorrow; Sofia finalize A/B copy; Marco update playbook; campbot re-run checks after fixes.
Dex: Will upload CSV and post here when done.
